title: FC 3502: Definitions
officialText:
3502.1 Definitions.

The following terms shall, for the purposes of this chapter and as used elsewhere in this code, have the meanings set forth in FC 202.

COMBUSTIBLE GAS DETECTOR.

HOT TAPPING.

HOT WORK.

HOT WORK AREA.

HOT WORK EQUIPMENT.

HOT WORK PROGRAM.

HOT WORK PROGRAM AUTHORIZATIONS.

RESPONSIBLE PERSON.

TORCH-APPLIED ROOF SYSTEM.
